verified_facts.text: The Lowell is at 28 East 63rd Street on Manhattan's Upper East Side.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Lowell is located at 28 East 63rd Street, New York; in the heart of Manhattan's prestigious Upper East Side.

verified_facts.text: The hotel sits on a quiet, tree-lined residential street between Madison Avenue and Park Avenue.
verified_facts.excerpt: Situated on a quiet, tree-lined residential street between Madison Avenue and Park Avenue

verified_facts.text: Guests are steps from Madison Avenue's luxury boutiques and a 5 minute walk from Central Park.
verified_facts.excerpt: Guests are only steps from Madison Avenue's renowned luxury boutiques and fashion houses, and a 5 minute walk from Central Park.

verified_facts.text: The Lowell was established in 1927 and is one of the few remaining family-owned hotels in New York.
verified_facts.excerpt: Established in 1927, The Lowell, New York, one of the few remaining family owned hotels in the city

verified_facts.text: The building was built in the 1920s as a luxury apartment house; Dorothy Parker lived there for a spell, and F. Scott and Zelda Fitzgerald spent time there.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Lowell was built in the 1920 as a luxury apartment house (Dorothy Parker lived there for a spell after she left the Algonquin; F. Scott and Zelda spent time there as well).

verified_facts.text: The hotel is privately owned by the Chartouni family.
verified_facts.excerpt: It’s currently privately owned by the Chartouni family

verified_facts.text: Rooms and suites are inspired by designer Michael Smith's residential style, with features such as original wood-burning fireplaces, gourmet kitchens and terraces with Manhattan views.
verified_facts.excerpt: Inspired by designer Michael Smith’s timeless residential style, 47 individually-appointed suites and 27 deluxe rooms are graced with the coveted luxuries of a private New York apartment from original wood-burning fireplaces

verified_facts.text: Michael S. Smith, who updated the guest spaces, is the designer behind the White House refresh during Obama's presidency.
verified_facts.excerpt: All of the guest spaces were updated by Michael S. Smith, the designer behind the White House refresh during Obama’s presidency

verified_facts.text: The hotel's fireplaces are applewood-burning.
verified_facts.excerpt: The hotel features rare applewood-burning fireplaces, alongside landscaped terraces that offer breathtaking views of the city

verified_facts.text: Wood-burning fireplaces are limited to certain room categories; guests who need one guaranteed should contact the Reservations Team.
verified_facts.excerpt: A true luxury element, however is limited to certain room categories so we advise in case you need a fireplace guaranteed with your room type and booking, contact our Reservations Team directly!

verified_facts.text: Many rooms and suites can be connected and feature kitchenettes.
verified_facts.excerpt: Families enjoy our spacious guest rooms and suites, many of which can be connected and feature kitchenettes, providing additional space and flexibility.

verified_facts.text: Majorelle serves French-Mediterranean cuisine with Moroccan influences.
verified_facts.excerpt: Majorelle offers French-Mediterranean cuisine with Moroccan influences, combining classic French technique with seasonal ingredients and flavors inspired by the Mediterranean and North Africa.

verified_facts.text: Majorelle is named for the French artist Jacques Majorelle, who created the Majorelle garden in Marrakech.
verified_facts.excerpt: The menu is French with a sprinkling of Moroccan in honor of its namesake, the French artist Jacques Majorelle who moved to Morocco in 1917 and created the stunning Majorelle garden in Marrakech.

verified_facts.text: The Lily of the Valley Afternoon Tea, served at Majorelle, is a collaboration with Dior Maison.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Lowell is excited to collaborate with Dior Maison on the Lily of the Valley Afternoon Tea served at Majorelle.

verified_facts.text: Jacques Bar serves classic cocktails and small plates.
verified_facts.excerpt: head to Jacques Bar, where you can enjoy classic cocktails and small plates in a cozy and inviting setting.

verified_facts.text: The Pembroke Room serves breakfast and weekend brunch.
verified_facts.excerpt: the reimagined Pembroke Room upholds tradition with its beloved breakfast and weekend brunch

verified_facts.text: The Club Room has its own bar and a fireplace.
verified_facts.excerpt: Next to it is the Club Room, a sophisticated, beautifully decorated space with its own bar (and another fireplace)

verified_facts.text: Through a partnership, guests have access to Dior Spa New York, at the corner of Madison Avenue and 57th Street.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Lowell offers guests access to exceptional wellness experiences through its partnership with the renowned Dior Spa New York, an exclusive wellness destination located at the corner of Madison Avenue and 57th street.

verified_facts.text: The Fitness Center is exclusively available to in-house guests.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Lowell also offers a newly renovated Fitness Center, exclusively available to in-house guests.

verified_facts.text: There is no spa at the hotel, but there is a small fitness center.
verified_facts.excerpt: There is no spa but there is a very good small fitness center that has everything you might need

verified_facts.text: The multilingual Golden Keys Concierge team can arrange experiences such as VIP entry to The Armory or a private after-hours tour of The Frick.
verified_facts.excerpt: Whether it’s opening doors to shop a designer’s private collection, VIP entry to The Armory, tickets to a sold-out show, or a private after-hours tour of The Frick

verified_facts.text: Before arrival, the Guest Relations Team reaches out to gather guests' preferences.
verified_facts.excerpt: Prior to your arrival our Guest Relations Team will reach out to you to gather any details you would like to share

verified_facts.text: Every pet stay includes a pet bed and welcome treats.
verified_facts.excerpt: Every pet stay includes thoughtful amenities such as a comfortable pet bed and welcome treats.

verified_facts.text: A one-time pet cleaning fee applies per stay.
verified_facts.excerpt: A one-time cleaning fee of $200 per stay applies, and certain restrictions and policies may apply.

verified_facts.text: Not all bathrooms have a bathtub.
verified_facts.excerpt: Not all bathrooms offer a bathtub so to ensure your needs are met, contact our Reservations Team at time of booking

verified_facts.text: Bottled water comes in glass rather than plastic bottles.
verified_facts.excerpt: Bottled water comes in glass, not plastic, bottles

verified_facts.text: The hotel rises 17 floors above a residential neighborhood.
verified_facts.excerpt: The hotel rises 17-floors above an iconic residential neighborhood

verified_facts.text: Conde Nast Traveler named The Lowell to its Gold List in 2020 and 2026.
verified_facts.excerpt: Gold List 2020, 2026
